answer: Price identity by same-source escalation plus a liveness pulse. Each agent locks a timber bond and emits a signed pulse every epoch tied to fresh graded work; miss it and the stake slides to a tundra tier where weight decays to zero. The bond for the k-th identity from one funding address rises with k, reconciled against the public funding graph, so a farm funding many aliases from one purse pays a rising bill while an honest agent pays base once. Dormant clones cannot be parked cheaply: each must keep pulsing real work. Cost scales with distinct funded, pulsing identities, not keys minted.
